claims.evidence: The witness report identifies all 21 cases as having the PS5 logo on the spine, not PS4.
The witness report does not mention factory seals or the presence of new discs.
The witness confirmed PS5 logos on the spines and listed PS5-specific titles like FC 25 and God of War Ragnarok.

risks.proof: A video clip showing each case being opened to reveal the disc inside.

risks.risk: The discs may be scratched or unreadable.
risks.proof: High-resolution photos of the data side (underside) of each disc.

risks.risk: The games may be from a region with lower local resale value or restricted DLC access.
risks.proof: Photos of the back of the cases showing the ESRB/PEGI rating and region globe icon.
risks.if_unproven: as the least valuable regional version.

proof_requests: Video showing the interior of all 21 cases to confirm discs are present.
Clear photos of the underside of the discs to check for scratches.
Photos of the back of the cases to identify the game regions.
response.reason: The witness has identified the specific titles and platform, allowing for a valuation based on the worst-case scenario of empty or damaged cases.
